Class ProtectionMetadata

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.workbench.encryption.ProtectionMetadata
public final class ProtectionMetadata extends Object
Upload-path protection descriptor for the workbench client.

Mirrors the transport ProtectionMetadata packet (global.thalion.ttio.transport.ProtectionMetadata): cipher_suite / kek_algorithm / wrapped_dek / signature_algorithm / public_key. This client-side variant adds a canonical JSON form used as a cross-language anchor.

Cross-language equivalent: Python ttio.workbench.encryption.ProtectionMetadata. toJson() is byte-identical to the Python to_json() (sorted keys, compact separators, standard base64), so a fixed BYOK metadata serialises identically across languages.
